paragraphs: Modo Labs sells an experience platform that connects apps, portals, and enterprise systems into one digital experience across mobile and desktop. The pages say universities use it as a campus experience platform and enterprises use it as a workplace experience platform. Modo AI is presented as orchestrating actions across campus and workplace systems rather than only answering questions.

The platform is described as carrying 100+ integrations, out-of-the-box templates, and customizable modules delivered through a mobile app and a desktop portal. The integrations page describes connecting back-end systems so that data, information, and services reach people in one place as the founding mission. Integration categories listed there include the student information system, the learning management system, safety and security, and authentication.

The about page says the platform was founded in 2010 by MIT's chief mobile platform architect. That page also records recognition as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Workplace Experience Applications. Case studies name universities and colleges including SUNY Plattsburgh, KCTCS, and Northampton Community College, alongside Northern Trust.

quote.text: Integrating disparate back-end systems to bring the data, information, and services people need in one easy-to-use place is Modo’s founding mission.
